source_evidence.independently_decoded_literal: We first apply this block notation to the reflection map \mathsf{U} from ( 2.14 ). We use the same symbol for its pullback on observables: (\mathsf{U}f)(x,y)\coloneqq f(\mathsf{U}(x,y))=f(x,2x-y)\,. (B.4) This pullback is self-adjoint and unitary, and hence has block matrix \mathsf{U}=\begin{pmatrix}\mathsf{U}_{\mathsf{P}\mathsf{P}}&\mathsf{U}_{\perp\mathsf{P}}^{*}\\ \mathsf{U}_{\perp\mathsf{P}}&\mathsf{U}_{\perp\perp}\end{pmatrix}\,. Here \mathsf{U}_{\mathsf{P}\mathsf{P}}=\mathsf{P}\mathsf{U}\mathsf{P} maps \mathfrak{H}_{\mathsf{P}} to itself, whereas \mathsf{U}_{\perp\mathsf{P}}=\mathsf{P}^{\perp}\mathsf{U}\mathsf{P} maps \mathfrak{H}_{\mathsf{P}} to \mathfrak{H}_{\perp} . Since \mathsf{U} is self-adjoint and unitary, \mathsf{U}_{\mathsf{P}\mathsf{P}} is a self-adjoint contraction on \mathfrak{H}_{\mathsf{P}} . Writing \mathsf{U}^{2}=I in blocks gives \mathsf{U}_{\perp\mathsf{P}}^{*}\mathsf{U}_{\perp\mathsf{P}}=I-\mathsf{U}_{\mathsf{P}\mathsf{P}}^{2}\,,\hskip 20.00003pt\mathsf{U}_{\perp\mathsf{P}}^{*}\mathsf{U}_{\perp\perp}=-\mathsf{U}_{\mathsf{P}\mathsf{P}}\mathsf{U}_{\perp\mathsf{P}}^{*}\,. (B.5)
